text:
alex: Quick ask — I'm about to land a CB tuning PR (reduces default max_batch to 128, tweaks queue drain timer). Can someone run a warmup+throughput probe on staging for a 1h window before we merge? Want to verify no regression on small-batch tail latency.

rachel: I can review the PR later today. Can you paste the exact run command you want us to use? Also which model/profile to test against? :eyes:

alex: thx. Use `gptx-25b/cb-profile` on the staging cluster (stg-us-west). Run with two configs: default (new defaults) and a control run (old defaults). Command: ```./tools/run_throughput --cluster stg-us-west --model gptx-25b --profile cb --duration 3600 --save results.json``` Add env overrides: `CB_MAX_BATCH=128` for new, and `CB_MAX_BATCH=256` for control. Also set `WARMUP_STEPS=200` to prime KV cache.

sam: pinging loadgen squad — I can kick this off but need the traffic shape. Do you want steady QPS or Poisson bursts? If we do bursts I can add 95th/99th quantiles in the output.

alex: steady ramp to 1000 rps over 5m, hold for 50m, decay 5m. Include a separate burst run: 2x peak for 2m every 15m.

jin: I'll run the warmup probe now on the staging pool flagged `cb-experiments`. Will post perf summary. I won't touch canary routing. If anything looks off I'll drop a snippet here.

maria: quick question — are we keeping `QUEUE_DRAIN_MS` at 8ms in the new defaults? That was causing slightly higher tail in my earlier runs.

alex: Good catch — PR sets `QUEUE_DRAIN_MS=6` for the new profile. That's why I want the warmup probe to catch any underutilization or micro-latency bumps.

leo: Suggestion: add a pre-run check to fill KV cache with typical prefixes, otherwise the first 10% of tokens will be cold and skew numbers. I have a tiny script: ```python3 tools/kv_warmup.py --model gptx-25b --steps 200``` Run that before the throughput command.

jin: ran control (old defaults) + warmup script. Posting quick lines from logs: `control: p50=21ms p95=89ms p99=210ms throughput=980rps tokens/s=1.2M error_rate=0.2%` Starting new defaults now.

maria: thanks jin. while that's running, I'll do a flamegraph sampling on one of the workers during a small-burst run to check queueing hotspots.

ops-bot: Scheduled job started: cb-warmup-probe-1718500000 on pool cb-experiments. Job id: job-8812. Expected duration 1h.

jin: new defaults finished: `new: p50=25ms p95=94ms p99=240ms throughput=995rps tokens/s=1.18M error_rate=0.25%` Slight increase in tails, throughput ok. Attaching raw `results.json` to the Canaries folder.

alex: rough delta looks small but p99 uplift is concerning. Maria — any evidence from flamegraph on queueing? Leo — could the reduced drain timer cause more fragmentation and cause slightly higher p99?

maria: flamegraph shows small spikes in the scheduler loop near queue checkout at the 95-99 window, correlated with the drain timer events. Looks like some workers do extra bookkeeping more often.

leo: yep, reducing drain timer increases frequency of batch flush checks; with small batch caps that can cause more wakeups. Two options: increase `CB_MAX_BATCH` to 160 or increase `QUEUE_DRAIN_MS` back to 8 only for the smaller GPU SKU. We can also make `QUEUE_DRAIN_MS` adaptive by avg-latency feedback.

rachel: my review notes (quick): leave a comment on PR suggesting adaptive drain + an AB test flag. Also add the KV warmup in the perf docs. Otherwise code looks fine.

sam: I can run the burst-pattern test tomorrow with flamegraph sampling enabled across 10% of workers so we can correlate p99 spikes with burst windows.

alex: plan: 1) hold merge, 2) add KV warmup step to quickstart perf guide, 3) try `CB_MAX_BATCH=160` + `QUEUE_DRAIN_MS=6` AB on staging, 4) run burst test with sam + maria collecting traces. @rachel please +1 after your final pass and we can merge to canary.

rachel: will do final pass end of day and leave either +1 or small tweak. Thanks for the run and logs everyone :thumbsup:

alex: awesome — thanks team. I'll update the PR with the suggested AB configs and docs. If anyone wants the raw traces ask and I'll drop links.
